name: m3_master_a
prompt:
One figure, full body from the top of the head to the feet, nothing cropped, plain white background, no scenery, no text, no frame, no shadow on the floor.
Both hands, wrists, elbows and shoulders clearly readable; fingers distinct where the prompt says where they are.

Image 1 is ONLY a grey framing and pose guide: copy the size and position of the figure in the frame and its pose, nothing else (no grey, no mannequin look). Design a NEW character: a pregnant woman of about 30 weeks, warm, calm and appealing, for a pregnancy app's short animated videos, in the style of Headspace and BUCK flat illustration: simple bold geometric shapes, flat colour, no outlines, no texture, no gradients, at most five colours (a warm skin tone, one dress colour, hair, shoes, one accent), very little interior detail, a clean silhouette.
She is drawn to be animated as a cut-out puppet, so:
- Seen from the side, turned just slightly toward us, facing RIGHT: her far arm is hidden behind her body, her near arm is fully visible.
- She wears a fitted SLEEVELESS knee-length dress that follows the round bump, and simple flat shoes. Her arms are bare from the shoulder: no fabric crosses the elbow or the wrist.
- Hair in a neat low bun that stays clear of her neck and shoulders.
- She stands relaxed, weight even, feet slightly apart. Her near arm hangs at her side, a little behind the bump, elbow very slightly bent; the hand is open and relaxed, fingers gently apart, the thumb clearly separate.
- A simple face in near profile: one eye, a brow, a small nose, a soft smile.
- Proportions about 7 heads tall, slim limbs, a clearly rounded bump.
